text: Pocket Bridge（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DSH 设置中查看并管理本机 Pocket Bridge 网关，为手机浏览器准备连接。插件将状态、连接信息、诊断和启停操作接入 DSH 的已认证本地 Web 服务；设置面板可刷新状态、检查 DSH 与安全连接就绪情况、启动或暂停网关，并按需显示本地生成的二维码和连接链接。适合希望从手机访问电脑上 DSH 的用户。启动网关需要 Node.js 24+；公共隧道还需要 cloudflared，插件可使用已安装的网关目录。

Pocket Bridge adds gateway controls to DSH Settings. The panel shows status, runs diagnostics, and starts or pauses the bridge. When a secure entrance is ready, it reveals a QR code and link for a phone browser. Startup requires Node.js 24+; public tunnels also need cloudflared.
想从手机浏览器连接电脑上正在运行的 DSH。
能不能在 DSH 设置里查看手机桥接是否就绪并启动它？
I want to check why my phone cannot connect to the DSH bridge.
Pocket Bridge 的功能「网关控制」：在 DSH 设置面板查看桥接状态，并提供启动、暂停和刷新操作；暂停手机连接时 DSH 本身及其任务仍继续运行。
Pocket Bridge 的功能「手机配对与诊断」：连接可用时在面板按需显示本地生成的二维码和链接；诊断列表检查网关、DSH 运行状态、加密状态及安全连接入口。

pocket-bridge README · Pocket Bridge： A lightweight, unofficial phone interface for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) running on your own Windows computer**. Open a browser on your phone to work with local projects and conversations, send instructions, respond to supported approvals, and transfer workspace files. Your computer runs DSH; Pocket Bridge provides the connection and a small browser interface.

pocket-bridge README · Pocket Bridge：**New releases focus exclusively on DSH.** Codex and Dot are retired from the new gateway and Windows installer. Previous combined releases and their installers remain available in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jyb114/pocket-bridge/releases), with no further integration updates. Upgrading preserves the installation directory, connection keys, device records, uploads, and existing local journals. It does not close Codex, delete its conversations, or remove your target applications.

pocket-bridge README · Pocket Bridge：Pocket Bridge is independent and unofficial. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, OpenAI, or Cloudflare. DSH, model access, and any provider fees are separate. See [third-party notices](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

pocket-bridge README · Pocket Bridge：Other community phone clients and plugins exist, including [DSH Mobile Remote](https://github.com/april-jk/dsh-mobile-plugin), [dsh-mobile](https://github.com/saya-ch/dsh-mobile), and [dsh-Remote](https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote). Pocket Bridge focuses on a small browser interface, a Windows installer, bounded thumbnail-first image viewing, protected content transport and exact-version compatibility reporting. Its optional plugin reuses an identified gateway and exposes actionable local diagnostics. Consult each project's own platform, protocol and security requirements before choosing it.

pocket-bridge README · What it does：- Browse projects on the computer, add an existing directory, and create conversations.
- Send messages and view streamed replies, exposed reasoning, tool activity, and queued messages.
- Check computer-side submission receipts after a reload or a prepared entrance change. Uncertain instructions are never resent automatically; identical intentional questions remain possible after explicit review.
- Select models and tool presets reported by the connected runtime. Check supported permission presets through a readback instead of assuming a command succeeded.
- Handle approvals, choices, and questions when the runtime exposes that capability.
- Upload attachments and browse, preview, or download permitted workspace files. Authorized image references near the transcript viewport load a small thumbnail first; opening or downloading the original is an explicit action. Supported attachment IDs use the runtime's session-authorized reader. Local file links remain subject to workspace or exact local approval checks; unavailable sources display an error rather than silently reading another file.

pocket-bridge README · What it does：Capabilities depend on the installed DSH runtime, its plugins, and the connected account. This is a purpose-built mobile interface, not a complete reproduction of every desktop plugin. Unsupported operations must be explained or unavailable rather than presented as working buttons. Read the [compatibility matrix](docs/DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md) and [manual acceptance record](docs/DSH-MOBILE-ACCEPTANCE.md).

pocket-bridge README · Images and local file links：Preview.21 recognizes supported local Markdown image and file links and builds image controls or file actions with DOM elements. A link is metadata, not permission to read a computer file; it is never turned into an unrestricted browser `href` or used to grant access. The new preview path does not automatically fetch remote image URLs.

pocket-bridge README · Images and local file links：Images close to the visible transcript request JPEG thumbnails no larger than 960 pixels on either side and 200 KiB. The Windows converter can choose a smaller size to meet that byte limit. The page runs at most two image reads concurrently, and each gateway runs one Windows conversion at a time with a bounded queue and deadline. Original reads remain limited to 8 MiB, 8,192 pixels per side and 20 million pixels. Thumbnail support depends on the PC's raster decoder; a failed thumbnail does not silently download the original.

pocket-bridge README · Images and local file links：Tap an image to open its original in the page, or choose **Download original**. Image blobs stay in bounded page memory; this view does not write them to browser persistent storage or the public asset cache. Changing the conversation or connection, or disposing the page, cancels pending work and releases its image URLs. Explicit downloads and DSH's own source files have separate storage lifetimes.

pocket-bridge README · Images and local file links：Workspace image paths use the conversation's real DSH workspace boundary. An outside-workspace raster needs an exact approval created locally with `scripts/approve-dsh-image.js`: supply the bridge installation with `--base`, its DSH home with `--dsh-home`, the exact `--session` and absolute `--file`, then `--approve`. The signed approval binds the gateway instance, session, canonical workspace and file, file identity and SHA-256, and expires after 24 hours. Use the same local command with `--revoke` to remove it. Model-generated text cannot create an approval. File changes, missing approval, expiry and revocation block a later server read; revocation cannot recall bytes already delivered or downloaded.

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：1. Install and sign in to DSH on the computer. Verify that it can open a project and reply locally.
2. Download the DSH-only Windows setup from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jyb114/pocket-bridge/releases). Older installers remain available there.
3. Install Pocket Bridge. An upgrade uses the saved installation location; choose a D: location for a new install if preferred.
4. Open the desktop console and verify that the detected DSH runtime is running. The console remains local to the computer.
5. Copy the complete HTTPS phone connection link. Keep its access key and `#k=` fragment private.
6. Open the link on the phone. Select a project and conversation, or add a computer folder and create one. The host computer must remain awake and connected.

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：Preview.21 is the image-preview candidate described in the [release notes](RELEASE_NOTES.md). Its actual interface was operated in a 390 by 650 desktop-browser phone viewport against real DSH 0.2.1-rc.2: a session's tool image loaded automatically and its original opened in the page. These observations are separate from a final installer and production recheck, and do not establish physical iPhone/Android or older npm-host acceptance. Earlier compact model, reasoning, goal and plan controls remain documented in [Preview.20 acceptance](docs/PREVIEW20-ACCEPTANCE.md). The desktop console retains its strict local **Start DSH** action. To close DSH, exit it from the DSH application.

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：The verified npm build path remains available, but npm publication is deferred pending authorization for the intended npm account and package name. Signing in to DSH does not authorize npm publication. A community website [Preview.19 catalog update](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/8350) was submitted separately; neither a prepared package nor a website entry establishes availability in the npm-backed public Discover index. See the [distribution instructions](docs/DSH-PLUGIN.md#preparing-an-npm-distribution).

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：The Windows installer bundles Node.js and cloudflared with their license texts. It does not bundle DSH. Temporary tunnel addresses can change after a restart; use the newly copied link when that happens. A tunnel that is unavailable or disconnected does not mean a message was accepted. Do not repeatedly send an instruction with an uncertain delivery result.

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：For **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017**, [DeepSeek recommends Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or newer](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news261017/). Preview.16 adds exact native-desktop recognition and plugin version admission for **0.2.1-rc.2**. Model names and choices come from the connected runtime. A plugin version declaration does not establish compatibility with every newer or older build; consult the exact-version acceptance record.

pocket-bridge README · Windows setup：Phone content requires browser WebCrypto in a secure context. Use the HTTPS tunnel, or a local HTTPS entry whose certificate your phone trusts. Ordinary LAN HTTP does not provide this context and is not a supported plaintext fallback. The local console provides HTTPS setup guidance; certificate trust must be configured separately.

pocket-bridge README · Optional DSH plugin：The plugin adds **Pocket Bridge** to DSH Settings, with explicit gateway start and pause, private QR pairing, and connection diagnostics. It uses the existing lightweight phone interface. A running local listener, an available encrypted connection, and successful phone delivery are reported separately.

pocket-bridge README · Optional DSH plugin：Install the tested `.tgz` from a release through the appropriate DSH plugin manager. The plugin requires a genuine Node.js 24+ runtime; internet tunnels require cloudflared separately. The Windows installer includes both. The plugin retains gateway data outside the replaceable package and does not close DSH when phone access is paused. See the [plugin guide and exact acceptance scope](docs/DSH-PLUGIN.md).
pocket-bridge README · Optional DSH plugin： *Actual plugin operation on npm DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2. Connection details are hidden; this is separate from physical-phone acceptance.*

pocket-bridge README · Source setup：Source users need Node.js 24 or newer. For an internet tunnel, install cloudflared separately or use the official distribution expected by the local configuration. Then run:

```powershell
node scripts/gateway-daemon.js
```

pocket-bridge README · Source setup：The desktop launcher and local console report the actual listener address; the gateway avoids claiming another application's occupied port. Runtime configuration and generated keys are local files excluded from this repository. Do not copy another person's configuration, access links, logs, or notification credentials into a public checkout.

pocket-bridge README · Source setup：DSH's official npm entry point is `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. Historical npm tests cover specific versions and flows, not a promise that every old or future build is fully compatible. DSH remains a rapidly changing developer preview. See the exact test limits in the [matrix](docs/DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [official project](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

pocket-bridge README · Privacy and transport：The supported phone content channels use authenticated encrypted requests and responses, including messages and protected workspace transfers. A passive tunnel relay receives ciphertext for those channels. It still sees traffic metadata and serves the initial web application; a relay that actively substitutes that application is outside this protection. The model provider necessarily receives the instructions submitted to it by DSH.

pocket-bridge README · Privacy and transport：The raw original DSH web interface is not exposed as a remote alternative in new releases. Open the original interface locally on the computer when needed. Encryption failures, missing keys, expired authorization, and unsupported capabilities must be reported without falling back to plaintext remote content.

pocket-bridge README · Privacy and transport：An optional [primary and backup Quick Tunnel pair](docs/DUAL-TUNNELS.md) is available for the Windows gateway and is off by default. Backup-address reminders can appear after every 1, 3 or 5 qualifying entries, a custom interval from 1 to 9,999, or never. The default is every entry. A fresh navigation or reload counts only after authentication and the encrypted connection are ready; conversation switches, reconnection and returning to an existing page do not count. Preferences and counts belong to the current browser origin. Choosing **Never** suppresses every automatic popup, including a changed address, while the manual backup panel remains available. If browser storage fails, the panel explains that the interval cannot be retained. The copied address carries no credentials; that other origin needs its own login and encryption-key setup before it can be used. Both paths share the same PC, network and Cloudflare service, so they are not independent disaster recovery.

pocket-bridge README · Privacy and transport：An optional [private Tailscale HTTPS entrance](docs/TAILSCALE-PRIVATE-HTTPS.md) can avoid serving the initial application through Cloudflare. It is disabled by default, preserves the bridge's device and encryption checks, and does not install or configure a VPN. Real phone enrollment and connectivity must be verified after the owner sets it up. The phone's Settings → Connection and compatibility panel shows the observed runtime and implemented interface coverage separately from release acceptance.

pocket-bridge README · Privacy and transport：Local DSH history, uploads, configuration, and browser drafts have separate storage boundaries. Do not assume that every file on the computer or phone is encrypted at rest. Optional notification services are separate external recipients. No personal notification script or account is included. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the precise scope.

pocket-bridge README · Mobile design：Pocket Bridge uses its own bridge mark and a shared set of simple controls. On phones, one top row contains the conversation heading and connection indicator. Session actions and activity controls live in the labelled menu; model, tool, permission and goal choices open from the composer's labelled options button. Long drafts scroll within a bounded input instead of occupying the transcript. The existing controls retain their state when moved, and return to their wider desktop layout when appropriate. Primary touch actions have at least a 44-pixel target. The interface uses system fonts and local assets, with light and dark palettes and Chinese, English, and Spanish text.

pocket-bridge README · Mobile design：Model and reasoning choices use the same compact card, with a back action that keeps the model list available. Successful picker choices close after 150 ms instead of 700 ms. Goal, plan and context-compaction controls use separate tabs; opening the goal tab does not fetch plan selection or command lists. Enter and exit plan actions are serialized, and closing or remounting a dialog clears its listeners and page-inert state. Completed or stale goal state cannot be presented as a confirmed edit. These interaction changes do not weaken runtime discovery, authorization, encryption or mutation readback.

pocket-bridge README · Mobile design：History is paged, unchanged message rows are reused, streaming updates are coalesced, and images load small thumbnails near the viewport before an explicit original read. These reduce work without removing content, authentication, or encryption. Network speed, tunnel stability, runtime discovery, and the amount of history can still affect response time; thumbnail-first loading is not a guarantee of a faster first conversation load.

pocket-bridge README · Mobile design：The computer's public-asset compression cache checks current source bytes and file identity on every request it receives. Brotli quality 5 reduces first-miss compression work; gzip remains at level 6. The largest Lite script is preloaded from its existing fingerprinted path without changing execution order. On a previously trusted origin, fixed public scripts can be reused from the phone's cache after their bytes, active pin and access-key epoch are rechecked. The emergency updater and manifest stay online; installing new code still requires the normal explicit verified update. A new origin or an empty cache still needs its first download. Private conversation and file responses are not added to this public cache.

pocket-bridge README · Mobile design：Concurrent modern-session queue, goal and model reads share only an in-flight request, with a one-second join window and fresh reads after mutations or connection changes. Repeated catalog updates preserve unchanged navigation buttons instead of recreating them. In the recorded desktop-browser tunnel run, static scripts and DOMContentLoaded improved, but first conversation content still took about nine seconds and did not beat the earlier run. Fresh Windows process discovery remains a measured bottleneck. See [Preview.18 acceptance](docs/PREVIEW18-ACCEPTANCE.md) for the actual timings, measurement method and device limits.

pocket-bridge README · Development and verification：```powershell
npm run ci
npm run audit
npm run scan:strict
```

The isolated suite covers the DSH/shared gateway, encryption, authorization, file scope, UI behavior, lifecycle, payload closure, and upgrade retention. It does not substitute for operating a real runtime or a physical phone. Live checks are recorded separately, with the runtime version, transport, observed result, and untested boundaries.

pocket-bridge README · Development and verification：Public product documentation is in English. User-facing mobile translations remain available. Report reproducible bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jyb114/pocket-bridge/issues); keep credentials, complete connection URLs, and private transcripts out of public reports. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for sensitive reports.
